# VantorX Solutions

> Done-for-you business systems: Custom Website Design, 24/7 AI Phone Receptionist (Ava), LeadFlow Speed-to-Lead SMS, and Client Hub CRM for appointment-driven local businesses and contractors.

VantorX Solutions designs, builds, and operates complete business infrastructure for local businesses and trade contractors. Clients never touch software or configuration—VantorX builds their website, connects their phone lines, trains their conversational AI receptionist, and maintains the entire operation 24/7.

## Core Services

- [Custom Website Design & Mobile Overhaul](https://www.vantorxsolutions.com/#website-design): Custom-built, mobile-responsive websites tailored to local trade contractors. Engineered for tap-to-call, speed, and high lead conversion.
- [24/7 AI Phone Receptionist (Ava)](https://www.vantorxsolutions.com/#services): Human-grade conversational voice AI answering every call in 1 ring 24/7/365, qualifying emergencies, and booking appointments into Google / Outlook calendars. Live Demo Line: (561) 813-8602.
- [LeadFlow Speed-to-Lead Follow-Up](https://www.vantorxsolutions.com/#services): Automated 90-second two-way SMS follow-up for web contact forms, Google inquiries, and quote requests before leads go cold.
- [Instant Missed-Call Text-Back](https://www.vantorxsolutions.com/#services): Automatically rescues unanswered daytime calls by sending a personalized text within 3 seconds to capture high-ticket jobs.
- [Client Hub Operations](https://www.vantorxsolutions.com/client-hub/): Centralized contractor dashboard displaying all call recordings, audio transcripts, scheduled jobs, and customer conversation histories.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO / GEO)](https://www.vantorxsolutions.com/#services): Entity-based AI search optimization ensuring local businesses are the #1 recommended answer when consumers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google Gemini.
